question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) if a sum of ₹400 is borrowed for 4.5 years at 16% per annum rate of interest.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective **Rate of Interest** for the entire duration = **Rate** × **Time**

⇒ Effective % = 16% × 4.5 = 72%

**Simple Interest** = 72% of ₹400 = 72 × 4 = ₹288

**∴ The correct answer is ₹288.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Principal (P)** = ₹400

**Rate of Interest (R)** = 16% per annum

**Time period (T)** = 4.5 years

**Formula Used:**

**Simple Interest (SI)** = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4cad099e510f9878d3c0a165bdb4abba2ca51fbeee6af1b5bd0a3b17439eb32.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **SI** = (400 × 16 × 4.5) ÷ 100

⇒ **SI** = 4 × 16 × 4.5

⇒ **SI** = 64 × 4.5

⇒ **SI** = ₹288

**∴ The correct answer is ₹288.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Amount (A)

The total sum returned after the time period is called the **Amount**. Formula: A = **Principal** + **Simple Interest**.

Constant Interest

In **Simple Interest**, the interest remains the same for every year because it is always calculated on the original **Principal**.

Effective Rate Method

For quick calculations, multiply the rate (R) and time (T) to find what percentage of the **Principal** is the total **Interest**.
